method: Population-weighted (ABS 2039.0 §2.2): a division's index score is the usual-resident-population-weighted average of its SA1s' cube scores, weighted over the SA1s whose score the cube publishes. SA1 assignment is the people-lanes join cache, one division per SA1.

cube.product: ABS 2033.0.55.001 SEIFA 2016, Statistical Area Level 1 indexes (Table 1)

about: ABS SEIFA 2016 SA1 index scores (IRSAD, IRSD, IER, IEO) pooled to the Northern State's 25 Legislative Assembly electoral divisions, usual-resident-population weighted per ABS 2039.0 §2.2 — the recipe the federal division store used for its own editions, here on the SA1→division assignment the frame's people lanes computed. Deciles rank the 25 division scores into tenth-equal bands (1 = least advantaged tenth of the 25); pct is the rank fraction used for ordering. Suppressed SA1 scores drop out of their index only (observed-population floor 90%).
